name: n8n (n8n GmbH)
what: Fair-code workflow-automation and AI-orchestration platform connecting LLMs, business tools and data sources in visual, code-optional workflows.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); the company's Series C post names Visionaries Club; the Growth Fund II register page shows n8n GmbH shareholder lists filed 2025-09-30, 2025-10-23 and 2026-04-27.
membership.quote: with support from Meritech, Redpoint, Evantic and Visionaries Club

entry.quote: We just raised $180 million in Series C funding

valuation.quote: the secondary share sale, which values n8n at more than double its previous valuation

notes: Entry: Visionaries is listed among the new investors in the Oct 2025 Series C, separately from 'previous backers including Felicis Ventures, Sequoia, Highland Europe and HV Capital' (company post, tech.eu, Osborne Clarke 2025-10-14). The Growth Fund II shareholder-list filings start 2025-09-30, consistent with the Series C closing then. Valuation: the latest priced event is SAP's May 2026 purchase in a secondary share sale at $5.2B, stated by n8n (tech.eu: 'jumpring from $2.5bn to $5.2bn ... n8n said'); recorded as kind 'tender' because it is a company-stated secondary price, not a primary post-money. If the judge admits only primary rounds, use the Series C: $2.5B post-money (company post: 'our valuation to $2.5 billion', 2025-10-09). Sibling split: Sequoia, Felicis and Accel carry $5.2B; HV Capital and Redpoint carry $2.5B. Focus: siblings split between AI & Applied AI (HV, Accel, Redpoint) and DevTools & APIs (Sequoia, Felicis); the company now sells itself as an 'AI orchestration platform' (the Visionaries card too), so AI & Applied AI; judge to align. Founded 2019 (HV sibling). No round after May 2026 found (googlenews '"n8n" raises'). Earlier rounds re-checked: $1.5M seed led by Sequoia (TechCrunch 2020-03-13); 'Felicis the Series A in 2021' and the EUR 55M ($60M) Series B led by Highland Europe at a sourced ~EUR 250M valuation (TechCrunch 2025-03-24); the Series A amount is not stated there (siblings give $12M / EUR 10M), left empty.
